messages:
maria: starting a greenfield run for sa-east-1 (internal codename: saturn). goal: create cloud account + project, VPC/VNet scaffolding, and validate GPU quota for an initial 8x A100-like machines. timeline: this week.
ollie: 👍 can you drop the CIDR plan? want to avoid overlapping with partner networks.
maria: Proposed CIDR: 10.200.0.0/16 split into /20s per AZ. public subnets: 10.200.0.0/22, private app: 10.200.4.0/22, gpu pool: 10.200.8.0/22 (isolated). using single NAT per AZ for resilience.
raj: question on NAT cost — do we want NAT GW per-AZ or a single autoscaled gateway? per-AZ NAT adds cost but simplifies path to GPUs (avoid cross-AZ egress).
amy: for initial dev we can use one small autoscaled NAT instance to save ~$200/mo, swap to NAT GW for prod. add a note to runbook.
maria: noted. will flag cost tradeoff in the runbook. estimated monthly baseline for the account (8 x GPU + infra + network) ~ $18k-$24k depending on reserved pricing.
netops: quick check: provider quota limit in sa-east-1 is low for gpus; submit quota request now. template: "Product: compute, SKU: A100-80GB, current: 0, requested: 8". include project ID and purpose = "Redwood inference - saturn pilot".
raj: earlier we saw AZ-level GPU shortages. can we plan for fallback region routing? ie primary sa-east-1, fallback sa-east-2 or sfo?
maria: yes — plan: route policy in control plane to prefer saturn, but if capacity < 4 GPUs, shift new allocations to fallback pool. will add automation to detect low_available_capacity metric.
ollie: for VPC peering: we need a shared-services VPC for logging and KMS. propose peering with 10.10.0.0/16 (shared-services). add IAM role that allows cross-project logging ingestion.
amy: KMS using customer-managed key (CMK) required for private deploys. add instruction to request key with key policy granting redwood-sre and customer admin.
maria: draft terraform snippet for project + vpc (very small):
```
module "project" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/cloud-modules.git//gcp/project"
  name   = "redwood-saturn-pilot"
  billing_account = var.billing_account
}
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/cloud-modules.git//gcp/vpc"
  project = module.project.id
  cidr    = "10.200.0.0/16"
  azs     = ["sa-east-1a","sa-east-1b","sa-east-1c"]
}
```
ollie: include instructions to run `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding` for the Cloud Build service account and to enable APIs: compute, cloudkms, iam, logging.
netops: deploy-bot: project redwood-saturn-pilot created (proj-12345) :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks. next: validation checklist for handoff to platform team: 
- project + billing verified
- VPC + subnets created and tested (can ping internal bastion)
- GPU quota approved and sample GPU VM launched 
- ingress NACL/SG baseline locked down 
- routing policy configured in control plane for fallback region 
- cost alert budget set at $30k/mo with slack alert
- KMS created and key rotation enabled
- log sink to shared-services verified
ollie: I'll own the ping tests, raj will own the GPU launch smoke, amy owns KMS and keys. tagging owners in runbook.
raj: GPU smoke plan: create 1 instance, run nvidia-smi, run small inference container that streams 5k tokens. check nvlink topology and dmesg for ECC errors.
amy: for keys: also add step to rotate test key and confirm decryption from both hosted and private runtime.
maria: one risk: provider marketplace images in sa-east sometimes lag driver updates; include driver compile fallback steps in runbook (install kernel-headers, apt install build-essential, install driver from provider or compile).
ollie: dev note: set host firewall to allow 10250, 10255 (kube), 5000-5200 for internal health probes.
maria: final step: schedule a 30-minute handoff call tuesday 10am PST with platform + netops + sre. will tag people in calendar invite. :calendar:
raj: sounds good. ping if quota stuck — we've seen support can take 48-72h.
maria: thanks team — putting the runbook draft in the infra-runbooks repo and will post link here once pushed. :shipit:
